title: Airport dreams
content: Lately I’ve realized I’ve had this dream a few times. I am in this airport. It seems like it’s all over the place but I’m too the point where I know where everything is. Thinking back on my first one, I realized I missed my flight. The second time I went there I was early but the plane was super futuristic and more like theatre seating. It finally came to me last dream that I’ve been here before. You come in and it looks like the second floor of a mall with escalators. You have to go to the left and down to check in then right back up to go down to then go back up. Anyway, I guess my mall world isn’t a mall after all- but an airport.
